message:
Disallow ClassLoader access via DataBinder (CVE-2022-22965 / Spring4Shell)

WebDataBinder: disallow binding to class.classLoader and class.protectionDomain
field patterns. Prevents attacker from overwriting Tomcat logging configuration
to achieve RCE via JDK 9+ module system (Spring4Shell / CVE-2022-22965).
Source: https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/commit/002546b3e4b8d791ea6acccb81eb3168f51abb15
author: spring-projects-team
diff:
// Fix: CVE-2022-22965 WebDataBinder ClassLoader access
// Disallow class.classLoader and class.protectionDomain parameter binding
